PM Modi posts second Instagram video, thanks followers

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has posted a second video on Instagram, thanking his followers for their "insightful responses." The video, described as being in a "Gen Z style," was posted late at night. One report notes the video's impact, stating PM Modi gained 1 million Instagram followers and broke a record after posting a late-night selfie video.
